lines.text: above the garden an airship pulled against the mast. somebody up there was leaving, and leaving fast.
i caught the gangway as the last rope let go. the city fell away. i didn't look below.
inside it was velvet and brass, and quiet, the expensive kind. the city was a mile down. up here, nobody minds.

lines.speaker: goon_a
lines.text: "no ticket, no seat, and nowhere to run."

lines.speaker: goon_b
lines.text: "it's a long way down, cutie. that's half the fun."
